## Pricing

**Solo — $0**

One developer, up to three private repos. You get the whole review engine, not a trimmed demo of it: every rule, every supported language, no cap on diff size. Reviews start on push and land as inline comments in about 90 seconds. No card.

**Team — $18 per developer, per month**

Everything in Solo, plus unlimited repos and the parts that only start to matter once other people read your code. Shared rule sets, so a convention you agree on in one repo applies across all of them. Searchable review history. When someone trips a rule the team wrote back in March, the comment links the discussion where you decided it. Billing counts active contributors only; a developer who pushed nothing this month costs you nothing.

**Enterprise — talk to us**

Self-hosted or single-tenant, SSO over SAML or OIDC, audit logs, and a signed DPA. You can write custom rules against our AST API and keep them in your own repo, where we never see them. Contracts here usually start near $30k a year. We quote after we've looked at your repo count and how you handle secrets.

---

Team is free for 14 days, no card. Annual billing takes 20% off. Cancel from the dashboard whenever you want and we refund the unused part of the month.

Open source projects get Team at no cost. Send us a link to the repo.

---

Two numbers are placeholders you'll want to check against reality: the 90-second review latency and the $30k enterprise floor. Both are the kind of specific that makes the page land, and both are worth cutting rather than fudging if they aren't true.
